description: Change the user's goal and daily targets — the same settings as the app's Goals screen. Send ONLY the fields to change. Each target takes a number (a custom target) or "auto" (computed from their body, activity and goal). The server keeps calories and macros consistent (protein×4 + carbs×4 + fat×9 ≈ calories), so the targets it returns can differ slightly from what you sent — report the returned ones. Current weight is not here: log a weigh-in with log_weight. Needs the user's "Change goals & settings" switch for this connection (whatevr app → Settings → Connections); if it's off you'll get a message saying so — relay it. The user is notified of every change.
name: update_goals
